theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (L : NNReal) (ρ : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → ∃ H : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P, (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K H) ∧ ∀ z : Euclid (n + 1), WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → ‖G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)))‖ < ρ → H z = WithLp.ofLp z 0 • G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) ∧ (DifferentiableAt ℝ G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) → (fun b => fderiv ℝ H z (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) = Fin.cons (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)))) (fun a => WithLp.ofLp z 0 • fderiv ℝ G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)))
